moves.text: Offer THE FINAL BOSS: Jayden Daniels for Patrick Mahomes.

reasons: You're 9-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 18%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 10 contenders (156.4 points a week).
Your weakest position is TE (6th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 3rd in 2027 and 4th in 2028 (title chances about 18%, 15%, 20%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 18% to 23%, and your lineup comes out -2.3 points a week ahead overall. Jayden Daniels adds 14.3 points a week for you today, but Patrick Mahomes is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 5,844, get 5,695), and it helps their lineup too (+2.3 a week), which makes it an easy sell.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 15% and 20% to 14% and 17%.
You have 2 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: DeVonta Smith is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (7.7 points a week).
Isaiah Likely is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (6.5 points a week).
Week 14 is your weakest projected week (164 points vs your usual 196), mostly byes.
Chris Olave's trade value has dropped 15% in 30 days.
